bio: Australia's largest theme park, with over 40 rides plus Tiger Island and WILD wildlife precincts.
Over 40 rides and attractions, including Tiger Island, make this Australia's largest theme park.
Theme park and oceanarium with marine mammal exhibits, rides and a wildlife rescue focus.
Gold Coast marine park with animal exhibits and rides, and work in wildlife rescue and rehabilitation.
Australia's only film theme park, opened in 1991 in Oxenford beside Village Roadshow Studios.
Film theme park in Oxenford, opened in 1991 and the only one of its kind in Australia.

Swim, picnic and paddle at the creek mouth beside Burleigh Head National Park.

Community-owned Aboriginal cultural centre at the foot of Burleigh Headland, with free entry and guided walks.
Oxenford water park that was Australia's most visited in 2019, with 1.12 million visitors.
Water park in Oxenford, open all year with some seasonal ride closures.
Seasonal water park with surf-themed slides, the Cave of Waves wave pool and a kids' Pipeline Plunge area.
Dreamworld's sister water park, with surf-themed slides and a wave pool.
More than 100 classic cars, buggies and motorcycles from 1911 onward, in Upper Coomera.
Upper Coomera museum with over 100 vehicles from 1911 to the early 2000s, on 12 acres.
Surfers Paradise arts precinct with a gallery, theatres, a cinema and dining.
Arts precinct whose gallery opened in 2021, replacing the city gallery that closed in 2018.
Large Southport park beside the Broadwater with play areas, barbecues and a water play area.
Marine Parade park on the Broadwater, reopened in 2009, with barbecue and water play areas.
